people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
translations.bsb: As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders.
translations.kjv: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous
translations.asv: As in the days of thy coming forth out of the land of Egypt will I show unto them marvellous things.
